title: Can't Replay Missions in GTA 6? No Replay Menu, Only 15 Saves 💾 #Shorts
description:
GTA 6 has no mission replay menu: once a story mission is done, you can't pick it again like in GTA 5 or Red Dead Redemption 2, and there are no gold medals. Your choices can change what happens later, which makes replays tricky. The workaround: 15 manual save slots (plus one autosave), but you can only save in free roam, never mid-mission, so save before every big job. Good news: Rockstar's Scott Butchard says robbery locations can be hit again and again.

Sources: IGN (via Insider Gaming), GTA BOOM, TechRadar (interview with Rockstar's Scott Butchard).
Images: Rockstar Games (An Extended Look).
